items.title: Metaplanet CEO shuts down Bitcoin sale speculation after $322M transfer
items.snippet: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich said no Bitcoin was sold after the company moved 5,014 BTC between custodial addresses for about $8 in fees.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Speculation on dogecoin is back to October 2025 levels. The price is down 70%
items.snippet: Futures positioning has rebuilt to levels last seen when dogecoin traded at three times today's price, and more than three accounts are betting on a rebound for every one betting against.
items.note: Позитивний тон для DOGE за ключовими словами.

items.title: Bitcoin slips near $63,500 as traders look past CPI to Fed’s next tests
items.snippet: An in-line inflation print removed a tail risk but gave BTC little reason to rally, leaving Jackson Hole, jobs data and the next CPI release as the market’s next catalysts.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: ASX shareholder plans to sue former directors over failed blockchain project
items.snippet: ASX’s failed blockchain-based CHESS overhaul faces renewed governance scrutiny after the exchange admitted misleading the market.
